ledger.note: 1027: the taifa of Silves is established. Infobox 'Established: 1027' ('Preceded by: Taifa of Badajoz'); the page title says c. 1037 and Cliopatria's first shape begins in 1040. The page names only 'Silves and the westernmost Algarve'.

1048: the Banu Muzayn take the throne. The page lists 'Banu Muzayn rule (from 1048)': Isa II al-Muzaffar 1048-1053, Muhammad II al-Nasir 1053-1058, Isa III al-Muzaffar 1058-1063; the 1027-1048 rulers are not on the page.

1063: Seville annexes Silves. 'Under Isa III, the kingdom was conquered by the taifa of Seville, led by Abbad II al-Mu'tadid' (infobox 'To Seville/Almoravid dynasty: 1063-1091'); the Seville page lists Silves among the conquests of Abbad II 'during his reign' (1042-1069) without a year. Cliopatria's Seville shape holds the cells from 1066.

1145: the second taifa of Silves is set up. 'The second, ephemeral taifa was established after the fall of the Almoravid dynasty' (Second period 1145-1150); the Almoravid page: 'The Muridun staged a major revolt in southwestern Iberia in 1144'. The infobox puts Silves under the Almoravids 1091-1145. The extent is Cliopatria's 1147 shape; the page is silent on it.

notes:
Silves is one Cliopatria row of four shapes (1040-1055, 1056-1065, 1147-1151, 1152-1168) but a state with two lives: the first taifa 1027-1063 (Banu Muzayn from 1048), absorbed by Seville in 1063, and the 'ephemeral' second taifa 1145-1150 after the Almoravid fall. Between 1064 and 1144 the dossier is landless (Seville 1063-1091, Almoravids 1091-1145 on the infobox). The 1152-1168 shape is marked wrong: the page ends the taifa with the Almohad conquest of 1150 ('To Morocco: 1150-1250'), and Cliopatria's Almohad shape does not contain the Algarve, so the almohad-caliphate dossier (af-02) should add these 20 cells for 1151-1168.
Not settled (pages silent): the taifa's extent (the page gives only Silves and the westernmost Algarve), the 1027-1048 rulers, the 1091 Almoravid conquest of Silves (the Almoravid page is silent), Sidray ibn Wazir and Ibn al-Mundhir (the page does not name them), the third period 1151-1168 on Cliopatria, the Almohad conquest campaign, Portuguese actions (Afonso Henriques 1189 is outside the shapes), whether Seville took Santa Maria do Algarve before Silves (Seville page gives no years), and Tejada (taifa-of-tejada, 1147-1151, one shared cell). The Ibn Qasi page is thin (undated); the Second Taifa period page does not exist under that title (url_not_found), so no page covered 1145-1150 beyond the Silves infobox.
